name: melox
description: 专为 iOS 和 MacOS 原生开发的第三方网易云客户端，使用 SwiftUI 并基于液体玻璃设计，参考 iOS 26.6 / MacOS 26.6 版 Apple Music 的 UI 并提供特色功能。  /   A native third-party NetEase Cloud Music client for iOS and macOS, built with SwiftUI and Liquid Glass, inspired by Apple Music on iOS 26.6 and macOS 26.6, with unique features of its own.
